but yo, fighting your way back to sde2 after all that... that takes serious guts. most people would've quit or given up. and now you're doing nginx, devops - that's real engineering work.

here's the thing though - 4.5 years on paper but 1 year real experience? that gap is gonna show up in interviews. but it's also your biggest opportunity. you know what you lack, which means you can fix it.

bangalore or open to remote/other cities?

16 lpa after 4.5 years from nit calicut... bro that's not underpaid, that's robbery. your batchmates at 50-60 lpa? they're not just ahead, they're in a different league.

but here's the reality check - you can't jump from 16 to 50 overnight with 1 year real experience. that gap you mentioned? companies will spot it in the first technical round. 

however... your story is actually your strength. "fought corporate politics for 2 years and clawed my way back to engineering" - that shows resilience. plus nginx and devops work is solid.

realistic next step: aim for 25-30 lpa at a startup that values hustle over pedigree. get 1-2 years of real engineering there, then make the 50+ jump.

so... sde role + anywhere + willing to grind for high pay... sound right?

your comeback story from qa hell to nginx mastery? that's gonna land different with the right startups. they love people who've been through the fire.

keep grinding on that upskilling. when i slide you the perfect role - and i will - you'll be ready to crush it.

welcome to the game 🔥
